descriptionHtml:
Steel frame. Taut mesh. It cools the way an open window cools.

Windermere is a raised cooling dog bed, a steel frame under a taut mesh deck, in Medium 90 × 70cm, Large 110 × 80cm and XL 130 × 90cm. No gel inside it.

By late June they have given up on their own bed. They lie in the kitchen doorway on the coldest tile they can find, shift onto the next one when that warms up, and you step over them twenty times a day.

Lifting the deck off the floor is what changes that. Warm air moves out from under them instead of sitting there between a thick coat and the ground.

What they get

  • Airflow on every side: Warm air moves away from underneath rather than building up beneath a heavy coat.
  • A firm even deck: Taut mesh carries their weight across the whole surface.
  • No gel and no batteries: Nothing to puncture, nothing to leak and nothing to recharge.
  • No cover and no washing: Wipe or rinse it. There is nothing to unzip and nothing to fight back on.
  • Three sizes, all usable: The whole deck is sleeping space, from 90 × 70cm to 130 × 90cm.

Best for: Hot sleepers, thick-coated breeds and summer in a house with no air conditioning.

Why it is worth the money

£79 for the Medium, £119 for the Large and £139 for the XL. If you have been through cooling mats before, you already know how that tends to go. Here the money goes into a steel frame and a mesh deck, with nothing inside them to leak or run flat.

And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

The trade-off is that mesh has no softness in it. An older dog who likes to sink into something will want a padded bed instead, or a blanket over this one once the weather turns.

Size and fit

SizeDeck (cm)Suits
Medium90 × 70Whippet, cocker spaniel, Staffy
Large110 × 80Labrador, springer spaniel, collie
XL130 × 90German shepherd, greyhound, golden retriever

The whole deck is usable sleeping space. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Wipe or rinse the mesh and frame and let it dry fully. Stand it on level ground and look over the joints now and then.

Shade and water still matter in hot weather. A raised bed does not prevent overheating.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

Is this just a summer bed? No. It goes out in the garden all summer and into a warm kitchen all winter.

How is this different from Bassenthwaite? Bassenthwaite is written for mud and wet coats and hosing down. This one is written for heat, and the Medium opens the range at £79.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Pick their deck size and give them a cool spot that is not the kitchen floor.
